versions.content: } When in main state COMM_PNC_ NO_COMMUNICATION at least one PNC bit representing this PNC in EIRA changes to ‘1’, the main state COMM_PNC_ NO_COMMUNICATION shall be left and the COMM_PNC_ READY_SLEEP shall be entered.

When in main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION at least one PNC bit representing this PNC in EIRA changes to ‘ 1 ’ and this PNC reference at least one ComMChannel via ComMChannelPerPnc (se e [ECUC_ComM_00880] ), the main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION shall be left and the COMM_PNC_READY_SLEEP shall be entered.
